Package com.tonic.analysis.source.ast.stmt

Class SwitchCase

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.source.ast.stmt.SwitchCase
  • public final class SwitchCase
extends Object
    A case clause of a switch statement, keyed by integer labels or expression labels.
